title: ShopLite multi-layer failure — OOMKilled pods, high latency, high error rate
description: ShopLite is experiencing simultaneous OOMKill events (exit code 137, 128Mi limit), P99 latency above 3000ms, and error rate above 78%. The last deployment changed memory limit from 256Mi to 128Mi and activated FAULT=oom. Between restarts, FAULT=oom also injects latency and random 500s. All three failure layers originated from one deploy workflow run.
